categories.label: VP marked on Scoring track
categories.hint: Final marker position on the Scoring track.

categories.label: Forest track sectors reached
categories.hint: Sector of your disk: 0/7/15 VP. Enter 0, 1 or 2 for first/second/third sector.

categories.label: Dune track sectors reached
categories.hint: Sector of your disk: 0/7/15 VP. Enter 0, 1 or 2.

categories.label: Masters in Stephens' factory
categories.hint: 1 VP per master on profession cards at Stephens' factory.

categories.label: Masters in lower small factories
categories.labelVi: Thợ cả ở xưởng nhỏ dưới

categories.label: Masters in upper small factories
categories.labelVi: Thợ cả ở xưởng nhỏ trên

categories.label: Professions you created that have an apprentice
categories.labelVi: Nghề của bạn có thợ học việc
categories.hint: 1 VP per apprentice on a profession card where you are the master.

categories.label: Fulfilled contracts
categories.hint: For each column: number of cards in column x cubes shown on fulfilled contracts in that column; enter the sum.

categories.label: Cubes in personal supply (needs ability 7a unlocked)
categories.hint: 1 VP per 2 cubes; enter 0 if ability not unlocked.

categories.label: Coins in personal supply (needs ability 7b unlocked)
categories.hint: 1 VP per 2 coins; enter 0 if ability not unlocked.

categories.label: Influence points on track (tiebreak; scores only if ability 7c unlocked)
categories.hint: 1 VP per influence point if unlocked. Enter 0 for VP if not unlocked but track the tiebreak below.

categories.label: Sets of 3 different accessories (needs ability 7d unlocked)
categories.labelVi: Bộ 3 phụ kiện khác nhau (cần mở khóa 7d)
categories.hint: 5 VP per set, counting spent (on contracts) and in supply; 0 if not unlocked.

categories.label: Remaining influence points (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Điểm ảnh hưởng còn lại (phân định hòa)

endCondition.description: Triggered when the French army marker reaches or crosses any player's Scoring-track marker; finish the round, everyone takes one more turn, then a final reset phase.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Ability-based categories (cubes, coins, influence, accessory sets) only score if the matching permanent ability on the player board is unlocked; enter 0 otherwise. Influence VP and the influence tiebreak share the same stat, so enter it in both rows. Solo Automa mode not modelled.
